notes: Stories created for Recruitment Status measure

EVAL-CT-M2-S1.title: Define Recruitment Status Measure Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M2-S1.description: Define normalized schema for clinical trial recruitment status (e.g., RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED) and scoring contract mapping statuses to evaluation signals.

EVAL-CT-M2-S2.title: Implement Recruitment Status Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-M2-S2.description: Implement logic to classify and score trials based on recruitment status (positive for RECRUITING, neutral/negative for COMPLETED or TERMINATED), including normalization of raw API values.

EVAL-CT-M2-S3.title: Expose Recruitment Status Measure via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M2-S3.description: Integrate recruitment status scoring into evaluate_care_facade output so downstream consumers receive structured measure data for each trial.

EVAL-CT-M2-S4.title: Unit Tests for Recruitment Status Scoring
EVAL-CT-M2-S4.description: Create unit tests validating status normalization and scoring logic across all major statuses (RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, UNKNOWN).

EVAL-CT-M2-S5.title: Integration of Recruitment Status with Clinical Trials Service Output
EVAL-CT-M2-S5.description: Integrate scoring into existing ClinicalTrials.gov fetch pipeline ensuring recruitment status is extracted, transformed, and included in final trial objects.
